title: 第一卷 第17章 我把自己奖励给你可好第一卷 第18章 这也太毒了
lines: “我…想选择好的体修功法！”陈玄说道：“只是我对这修炼也不是很了解！”
“反正品级越高的越好！”秦雪儿说着，她五指一抓！
陈玄只感觉到自己的面前，一股气流瞬间浮动而出，紧接着，三本功法，便出现在了他的前方。
“这三本，都是玄阶高级的炼体功法，这个级别的功法即便是在将军府，也只有三本，只有立下大功者，才能够选择。”秦雪儿说道。
“我可以选吗？”陈玄心中激动。
“大娘让你选什么级别的？”秦雪儿问道。
“大夫人说玄级功法，并没有说玄级什么级别的。”陈玄道。
“那你就可以选！”秦雪儿道：“这第一本，名叫烈阳决，修炼至第三层之后，你体内的内劲可诞生火焰！杀伤力不小！”
“第二本，叫回春决，这是一本纯粹的横练功法，修炼至第三层之后，你的内劲会有着极强的恢复能力，一般的小伤，内劲游走，便可瞬间恢复。这第三本叫做玄冰决，顾名思义，到了第三层之后，可诞生寒冰内劲。”秦雪儿说道：“你自己选择一门吧！”
陈玄直接抛起了第二本。
这特么就是用来当沙包的。
他仔细想了一下，还是选择了烈阳决！
看到陈玄做出了选择，秦雪儿连忙将两本书归位，而后他拉着陈玄朝着楼下跑去道：“秦爷，咱们选好了！”
秦爷抬头看了一眼陈玄，淡淡的说道：“自己回去将内容记下，三日后归还！另外，功法不可外传，一经发现，便是死罪一条！”
“是！”陈玄说道。
他心里兴奋得不行，玄阶高级功法啊！
玄阶初级的，就已经是千两银子了，这玄阶高级的功法，价值几何，他简直难以想象！
“好了，快去给我做饭吧，我快饿死了！”秦雪儿说着，她直接拖着陈玄，风风火火的就朝着后厨跑去！
很快，两人便来到了后厨。
这一路过来，陈玄没有一步是自愿跨出来的，即便如此，他也跑得气喘吁吁，但是秦雪儿却和没事儿的人一样，到了之后，她就说道：“快做饭吧，我要吃中午那个回锅肉…”
陈玄无奈，他喘息了几口，在厨房找了一些食材，便开始做了起来。
秦雪儿并没有靠近厨房，她只是远远的看着。
陈玄一边做菜一边问道：“二小姐，你是气修？”
“我是气体双修呀，而且都已经到了四品，厉害吧！”秦雪儿抱着剑，得意的说道。
陈玄对于四品什么的，没有什么概念，但是他脸上却说道：“厉害，厉害！”
然后他一边做饭，一边旁敲侧击的去询问着一些修炼方面的东西。
秦雪儿倒也在给他解答，过了一阵，秦雪儿疑惑的问道：“话说，你不怕我？”
“啊！”陈玄愣了一下，然后说道：“二小姐长得这么漂亮，为何要怕？”
秦雪儿神色一顿道：“你这小嘴儿倒是挺甜的，我的意识是，那些下人和我说话，都是恭恭敬敬，生怕多说一句话，但是你却和他们似乎不一样。”
陈玄笑了笑，他没有回答这个问题。
而秦雪儿很快就被陈玄炒菜的香味吸引住了，她吞了吞口水，等待着。
不多时，三碟菜肴就端到了桌子上，因为只剩下了一些冷饭，陈玄也简单的做了个蛋炒饭。
秦雪儿直接蹲在了后厨的凳子上，就开始狼吞虎咽了起来！

"I... want to choose a good physical training method!" Chen Xuan said: "It's just that I don't know much about this practice!"
"Anyway, the higher the grade, the better!" Qin Xueer said, grabbing it with her five fingers!
Chen Xuan only felt a stream of air floating out in front of him, and then, three skills appeared in front of him.
"These three books are all Xuan-level advanced body-training techniques. Even in the General's Mansion, there are only three books of this level of techniques. Only those who have made great achievements can choose them." Qin Xueer said.
"Can I choose?" Chen Xuan was excited.
"What level did the aunt ask you to choose?" Qin Xueer asked.
"The eldest lady talked about Xuan level skills, but she didn't say what level Xuan level is." Chen Xuandao.
"Then you can choose!" Qin Xueer said: "This first book is called Lieyang Jue. After you practice to the third level, the inner energy in your body can create flames! It is very lethal!"
"The second book is called Rejuvenation Technique. It is a pure horizontal training method. After practicing to the third level, your inner energy will have a strong recovery ability. If the internal energy wanders away from ordinary minor injuries, it can be recovered instantly. The third book is called Xuanbing Jue. As the name suggests, after reaching the third level, the inner energy of ice can be born." Qin Xueer said: "Choose one yourself!"
Chen Xuan directly threw up the second book.
This is just used as a sandbag.
He thought carefully and chose Lieyang Jue!
Seeing that Chen Xuan had made his choice, Qin Xueer quickly put the two books back in place, then he pulled Chen Xuan and ran downstairs and said, "Master Qin, we have made our choice!"
Master Qin raised his head and glanced at Chen Xuan, and said calmly: "Go back and write down the contents yourself and return them in three days! In addition, the skills cannot be passed on to others. Once discovered, it will be a capital crime!"
"Yes!" Chen Xuan said.
He was extremely excited, what an advanced Xuan-level skill!
The Xuan-level junior level is already worth a thousand taels of silver. He can hardly imagine how much this Xuan-level advanced skill is worth!
"Okay, go and cook for me, I'm starving to death!" Qin Xue'er said, she dragged Chen Xuan directly and ran towards the kitchen in a hurry!
Soon, the two came to the kitchen.
Along the way, Chen Xuan did not take a single step voluntarily. Even so, he was out of breath while running, but Qin Xueer acted like someone who had nothing to do. After arriving, she said: "Let's cook quickly, I want to eat the twice-cooked pork for lunch..."
Chen Xuan was helpless. He took a few breaths, found some ingredients in the kitchen, and started cooking.
Qin Xueer did not approach the kitchen, she just watched from a distance.
Chen Xuan asked while cooking: "Second Miss, are you a Qi cultivator?"
"I am a dual practitioner of Qi, and I have already reached the fourth level. Isn't that awesome!" Qin Xueer said proudly, holding her sword.
Chen Xuan had no idea about the fourth grade or anything, but his face said: "Awesome, awesome!"
Then while he was cooking, he asked about some cultivation matters in a sideways manner.
Qin Xueer was also giving him answers. After a while, Qin Xueer asked doubtfully: "By the way, are you not afraid of me?"
"Ah!" Chen Xuan was stunned for a moment, and then said: "Second Miss is so beautiful, why should you be afraid?"
Qin Xueer paused and said, "You are quite sweet with your little mouth. I realize that those servants are all respectful when they talk to me, for fear of saying another word, but you seem to be different from them."
Chen Xuan smiled, but he did not answer the question.
Qin Xueer was quickly attracted by the smell of Chen Xuan's cooking. She swallowed her saliva and waited.
Not long after, three plates of dishes were brought to the table. Since there was only some cold rice left, Chen Xuan simply made egg fried rice.
Qin Xueer squatted directly on the stool in the kitchen and started gobbling it up!
